tools.name: eplan_get_workflow
tools.description:
Read current EPLAN guidance and its reference catalog, or a revision/hash-pinned reference.
Call without arguments first. Guide content is not write approval or a native EPLAN claim.
Rediscover after stale pins; preserve the selected endpoint and engineering receipt IDs.

tools.name: eplan_status
tools.description: List configured source roots, installed backends, supported formats and extraction limits.

tools.name: eplan_concurrency_status
tools.description: Inspect per-process request admission, queue and worker limits; control calls remain responsive under load.

tools.name: eplan_get_transaction
tools.description: Read a durable write receipt/result. An abandoned owner is reported unknown; no operation is retried.

tools.name: eplan_list_files
tools.description: Inventory a configured drawing root recursively. Unsupported CAD formats can be listed too.

tools.name: eplan_inspect
tools.description: Extract source SHA-256, metadata, units, entity counts, layouts, PDF page count and limitations.

tools.name: eplan_get_entities
tools.description:
Read CAD entities and geometry properties by layer/layout/type/handle. Block coordinates are local.

INSERT entities include transforms and attached attributes. Use layout '@block' and block name for
definitions. Polyline vertices are limited to 256 per record; eplan_entity_vertices retrieves slices.

tools.name: eplan_get_text
tools.description:
Read/search literal CAD text, block attributes or positioned PDF text. PDF pages are one-based.

Every row has a record_index plus CAD handle/location or PDF page/bbox. Long text is explicitly
truncated at 8000 characters; eplan_read_text_record retrieves full text in slices.

tools.name: eplan_read_text_record
tools.description: Read a slice of one text record, using its zero-based record_index. Maximum length is 16000.

tools.name: eplan_entity_vertices
tools.description: Read LWPOLYLINE vertex slices [x,y,start_width,end_width,bulge] using a CAD entity handle.

tools.name: eplan_get_layers
tools.description: Read CAD layer names, colors, linetypes and off/frozen/locked flags.

tools.name: eplan_get_blocks
tools.description: Read block definitions, base points and xref paths. Read INSERT entities for attributes/placements.

tools.name: eplan_get_dimensions
tools.description:
Read dimension entities, raw measurement, type, text override and definition points.

Values are not formatted dimension labels; dimension style rounding/scaling is not applied.

tools.name: eplan_get_references
tools.description: List declared xrefs, image and PDF/DWF/DGN underlay paths; never open or load references.

tools.name: eplan_get_pdf_pages
tools.description: Read PDF page sizes, rotation, text counts, image counts and image-only OCR candidates.

tools.name: eplan_get_pdf_tables
tools.description: Detect and extract PDF table cells on one one-based page; verify against eplan_render_preview.

tools.name: eplan_index_project
tools.description:
Index 1..5 files into app-owned search state. Continue next_offset until null; inspect failures.

This writes only the server's cache/index and preserves all source files.

Optional request_id provides durable idempotency; inspect eplan_get_transaction after a lost response.

tools.name: eplan_search_project
tools.description:
Search indexed drawing text/attributes literally across one root with exact provenance.

Stale or deleted files are excluded. Coverage reports missing/stale sources; index first.

tools.name: eplan_compare_drawings
tools.description: Compare text multiplicities and layer/block names across two files; structural content diff only.

tools.name: eplan_render_preview
tools.description:
Write a PNG preview in app-owned state. PDF page is one-based; CAD uses an exact layout name.

Width is limited to 3000 pixels. CAD rendering is approximate and may omit unsupported entities.

Optional request_id provides durable idempotency; inspect eplan_get_transaction after a lost response.

tools.name: eplan_build_electrical_project
tools.description:
Build immutable project evidence after eplan_index_project. WDP supplies membership; explicit reports
supply native assertions. Reports: [{relative_path, kind, field_map?}]; kinds components, panel,
plc_connections, from_to, network, drawing_map. DWGIX requires an explicit FILETIME mapping.
Writes app-owned state. PDF text stays an unassociated candidate. No native engine validation.

Optional request_id provides durable idempotency; inspect eplan_get_transaction after a lost response.

tools.name: eplan_get_electrical_project
tools.description: Read project counts, checks and current source freshness. Historical snapshots remain readable.

tools.name: eplan_get_device_inventory
tools.description:
Read tags, descriptions, manufacturer/catalog, equipment codes and source handles.
Devices are physical occurrences, including child and panel roles. PDF candidates are separate.

tools.name: eplan_get_plc_io
tools.description:
Read controller/rack/slot/channel/address, devices, wires and terminals. Unknown values stay null.
Optional bounded graph traces carry explicit incomplete/branching status and evidence bases.

tools.name: eplan_get_connections
tools.description: Read graph edges with source objects/report rows, wires/cables and evidence classification.

tools.name: eplan_trace_connection
tools.description:
Trace documented electrical or network paths. Associations never imply continuity.
Stops at a destination device/terminal; continue from that device to follow another segment.
Returns unresolved ends, branching and explicit budget truncation, with connection IDs for evidence.

tools.name: eplan_get_equipment_groups
tools.description: Read explicit installation/location/panel/station groups and separate WDP membership groups.

tools.name: eplan_get_network_inventory
tools.description: Read documented device addresses, ports/interfaces and unassociated text literals. No network access.

tools.name: eplan_check_drawing_consistency
tools.description:
Review duplicate tags, address conflicts, missing descriptions, references and panel differences.
Missing scope produces potential conflicts; unavailable comparisons remain explicitly not evaluable.

tools.name: eplan_compare_electrical_revisions
tools.description: Compare semantic device/connection records in two historical snapshots with source provenance.

tools.name: eplan_export_electrical_project
tools.description:
Write and readback-verify a complete JSON export in app-owned state; return path/hash.
Optional request_id provides durable idempotency; inspect eplan_get_transaction after a lost response.

tools.name: eplan_capabilities
tools.description: Read export schema, supported analyses and native EPLAN boundaries before importing reports.

tools.name: eplan_import_reports
tools.description:
Create immutable EPLAN evidence from declared CSV/TSV/JSON/flat XML exports.

Each declaration: {relative_path, kind, field_map?, row_tag?, delimiter?, evidence_relative_path?}.
Kinds include devices, connections, plc_io, terminals, cables, parts, network, pages,
supplies, supply_links, supply_references and bridges.
field_map maps canonical field to exact source column. XML requires exact row_tag.
evidence_relative_path selects an eplan-row-evidence/1 sidecar for reviewed drawing rows.
Every row needs reviewer/note and hash/page/exact text-record quotes from indexed PDFs.
These remain reviewed drawing assertions, not authenticated exports or native validation.
Writes only private state; source reports remain unchanged. Native ELK/ZW1 cannot be imported here.

Optional request_id provides durable idempotency; inspect eplan_get_transaction after a lost response.

tools.name: eplan_get_export_snapshot
tools.description: Read snapshot counts, declared mappings, limitations and current source hashes/freshness.

tools.name: eplan_query_export
tools.description:
Query exported devices, connections, PLC I/O, terminals, cables, parts, network or pages.

Includes raw properties, explicit canonical mapping, source SHA-256 and row ordinal.
Does not combine records by unqualified device tags. Unknown properties remain raw.

tools.name: eplan_check_exports
tools.description:
Review potential duplicate device tags, PLC/network addresses and missing connection endpoints.
Duplicate functions can be legitimate; findings require review and are not native check-run results.

tools.name: eplan_trace_export_connection
tools.description:
Trace exact source/target tag+terminal assertions from exported connection rows.
Requires full structured tags. No implicit device-internal bridges or physical continuity claims.

tools.name: eplan_compare_export_snapshots
tools.description: Compare mapped export records, preserving duplicate multiplicity and both source manifests.

tools.name: eplan_export_snapshot
tools.description:
Write and readback-verify JSON evidence in private state; returns artifact path and SHA-256.
Optional request_id provides durable idempotency; inspect eplan_get_transaction after a lost response.

tools.name: eplan_read_archive
tools.description:
List ordinary ZIP entries or read one exact member using xml/link/text/bytes/streams.
Access/ACE member operations are refused by the selected offline profile.
Native ZW1/ZW9 are not treated as ZIP. Members are size-bounded, CRC-verified and isolated.
reader_options supports record_tag, query, table, byte_offset, byte_length, stream_offset,
minimum_length, text_encoding only. Pagination applies to the selected member reader or ZIP inventory.

tools.name: eplan_read_eod_slots
tools.description:
Experimental EOD byte-slot reader with raw header integers and offset-bound text candidates.
Infer slot size only from repeated header intervals that exactly divide the file, or provide
an explicit size. Does not establish active objects, property meanings or connectivity.

tools.name: eplan_read_xml
tools.description:
Inspect XML tags or read exact record_tag matches with raw attributes and nested children.
Omit record_tag for schema discovery. Includes ordinal provenance; no property IDs are guessed.

tools.name: eplan_read_access
tools.description:
Refused by the selected direct offline profile; never acquires an Access/ACE provider.
The signature is retained for compatibility. Raw MDB byte/text evidence remains available.
Uses Windows ACE in read-only mode against an isolated copy. No arbitrary SQL or saved queries.
Table row ordinals reflect provider order under the returned source hash, not inferred keys.
For a full cell, supply column and zero-based row offset; start/length slice text or binary data.

tools.name: eplan_read_project_link
tools.description:
Read ELK/ELL link text and bounded inventory of its local EDB folder, without opening EPLAN.
Target must stay under the configured root. Folder inventory is not an atomic project snapshot.

tools.name: eplan_read_binary_bytes
tools.description:
Read at most 4096 bytes as hex from local EPLAN data or a checksum-valid zlib stream.
byte_offset refers to source bytes, or inflated bytes when stream_offset selects a stream.

tools.name: eplan_find_compressed_streams
tools.description:
Find checksum-valid zlib streams whose headers start within a bounded 4 MiB source window.
Continue next_scan_byte_offset for coverage; scan budgets and record pagination are separate.
These are compressed byte streams, not decoded EPLAN object records.

tools.name: eplan_read_binary_text
tools.description:
Read offset-bound text candidates from raw or inflated local data.
Default is ASCII/ASCII-compatible UTF-16. Explicit text_encoding accepts utf-8, utf-16-le,
utf-16-be or cp1252; invalid units split runs. Align UTF-16 at the selected byte_offset.
False positives and window-edge fragments are possible. No electrical identity/relationship inferred.

tools.name: eplan_get_device_profile
tools.description:
Read exact-tag device descriptions, IPs, PLC I/O facts and power/air supply summaries.
Uses declared exports or explicitly reviewed drawing rows. Retains quote/hash references,
conflicting facts and known scope ambiguity. Reviewer labels are not authenticated.
Facts retain sources; first ten per field are returned with full counts. Use query_export for more.

tools.name: eplan_trace_device_supply
tools.description:
Trace upstream power or air feeds from explicit terminal relationships to reported supplies.
medium is electrical or pneumatic. connections/bridges require explicit flow_direction;
supply_links declare source-to-target flow by kind. No bridges, ratings or live valve states inferred.
reported_references retains feed labels/sheet references; these never create terminal graph edges.

tools.name: eplan_collect_device_evidence
tools.description:
Collect source-bound device text, IP literals, power/air labels and I/O-address candidates.
Index drawings first. category: device, ip, power, air, io or omitted for all. When device_query
is supplied, include exact literal matches and PDF text within radius points on that same page.
Proximity is candidate evidence only: it never establishes device ownership or feed connectivity.

feature_profiles.assessment_scope: Implementation availability; selected direct-profile lifetime coverage is separate from current artifact and host acceptance

native_thread_pool_policy.reason: Fixed standalone pre-import numerical limits; preloaded hosts refused; selected direct runtime measurements are separate from configured limits

vendor_native_readers.reason: Explicit profile and pinned ODA copy-only conversion; selected DWG read/preview and descendant cleanup covered. Revalidate changed vendor/runtime bytes. Access/ACE stays disabled.

http_transport.reason: Only direct stdio serving is enabled; HTTP startup refused before config load

framework_020_runtime.reason: Reviewed 0.20 wheel/pins; selected direct MCP/ODA lifetime coverage; optional shared host is not selected

endpoint_instance_admission.reason: Twelve lightweight metadata leases per state; at most four on-demand analysis operations (configuration may be narrower). Parser/ODA limits are unchanged. Legacy endpoint leases are never stolen.

parent_exit_cleanup.reason: Selected direct EOF, client loss with held writer, supervisor death and ODA descendants covered; no shared GUI adoption

owned_process_lifecycle.reason: Handle-bound normal/failure/cancellation teardown and selected actual MCP/ODA descendant coverage; no PID/name cleanup

shared_resource_ledger.reason: Reservations, creation-bound binding, reconciliation and revision-bound orphan/idempotence covered; uncertain barriers preserved

framework_host_ownership.reason: Serve/proxy entry points refuse startup until shared leases and framework backend-tree containment are accepted

installer_lifecycle.reason: Install-only setup and disposable CMD forwarding/help/failure checks; no server/native/plugin/global-config activation. Automatic plugin registration remains unavailable.

skills_and_guides.reason: Canonical tool/reference/catalog reads; explicit atomic publication

direct_discovery_cache.reason: Modern tools/list only; private 1000 ms TTL; invocation still runs policy/revision checks

guidance_notifications.reason: Framework live resource notifications wired; reconnect/refetch tested, native host delivery not accepted

framework_catalog_watch.reason: Optional framework host is not selected; standalone SDK discovery uses its immutable per-generation catalog

index_and_import_progress.reason: Backend returns real final file/report stage observations; frontend counters show admission, not live backend stages. Live stage streaming is not advertised.

cooperative_cancellation.reason: Frontend disconnect/cancellation stops its owned ephemeral analysis tree. Committed private units remain; interrupted write receipts can stay unknown. Never infer rollback or replay.

local_data_cancellation.reason: Single parsers have no intra-worker checkpoints; their private owned trees stop on cancellation under existing worker budgets. No native editor or shared software is acquired.

tasks.reason: No durable app-owned batch job/worker lifecycle or trusted job-owner binding; synchronous analysis does not survive process loss

approval_continuations.reason: No native engineering writes; ordinary private offline analysis does not need new approval prompts

direct_report_resources.reason: Private snapshot IDs, verified content hash/freshness, 16000-byte reads; query tools remain available

framework_report_relay.reason: No app-authorized report resource relay configured; ordinary backend report tools remain available

report_update_notifications.reason: Report identities are immutable; no authorized source-freshness watcher or mutable per-owner artifact channel exists

native_codex_skills.reason: Packaged bootstrap retained; protocol tests do not activate the native loader

redis_oauth_apps.reason: Optional profiles are not required or enabled by this app

device_information: reviewed drawing rows with hash/quote bindings
reported feed/sheet references with unresolved port connectivity
capabilities.mapping: field_map maps canonical names to exact exported column/property names; no numeric property IDs guessed
capabilities.workflow: Import explicitly declared exports; query snapshot_id; inspect freshness on every response.

reviewed_drawings.requires: Indexed PDF, original SHA-256, page and exact text-record quotes for every row
reviewed_drawings.boundary: Caller review assertion; quote/hash validation does not prove engineering meaning or authenticate the reviewer
